headline: Otter.ai secured $320 million in growth financing for its AI notetaker
body: Otter.ai secured $320 million in growth financing from the Customer Value Fund (CVF) of General Catalyst, the company said in a press release on Tuesday. According to the release, Otter will invest the new financing in enterprise growth, international expansion and product innovation.
note: For enterprise buyers, the test is whether the tool becomes more than a meeting recorder.

figure.label: growth financing from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund

evidence.text: Otter.ai secured $320 million in growth financing from General Catalyst ’s Customer Value Fund (CVF) to accelerate the growth of its artificial intelligence notetaker and conversational knowledge platform, the company said in a Tuesday (Oct. 20) press release .
Otter will invest the new financing in its enterprise growth, go-to-market strategy, international expansion and product innovation, according to the release.
